read_scope.notes: Read all 22 PDF pages, including references and Appendices A–G, through complete text extraction and page-by-page rendered inspection. Visually inspected all five figures and all twelve tables. Consulted the frozen paper.tex and specificity_results.tex for exact wording, equations and locations. Technical appendices were treated as optional depth when judging main-text accessibility. The PDF has 22 pages; the abstract contains 151 whitespace-delimited words after rendering TeX escapes. No other reviews, earlier manuscripts, progress records or non-snapshot manuscript were consulted.

score_reasons.expression: Excellent, precise English with manageable sentences and stable distinctions among aligned response, error, scene averaging and calibration. Section 4.1 explains the central contrast before introducing symbols, and Section 5 consistently distinguishes estimates from resolved comparisons. The abstract’s compressed description of the change in the lowest error estimate is a localized wording refinement rather than a pervasive clarity problem.
score_reasons.structure: The main text follows a coherent question–design–measurement–results–interpretation sequence. Sections 4.3–4.4 visibly separate the declared inferential family from retrospective diagnostics, and detailed derivations, controls and historical cohorts remain optional appendices. Results 5.3–5.5 develop the aggregate finding instead of becoming an undifferentiated inventory. The short conclusion could better carry forward the diagnostic insight about pair coverage and calibration that is prominent in the abstract and results.
score_reasons.new_reader_understanding: A reader unfamiliar with the project can recover the six prompt conditions, finite digital reference target, scaling units, repeat correction assumptions and score benchmarks from the main text. The Monet–Sisley lightness example and the expected errors 1, 0 and 1 for no, exact and doubled contrasts are particularly effective. Tables 2–5 and Figures 1–3 provide readable numerical and visual anchors. Only the abstract’s compressed before/after calibration wording briefly leaves the precise comparison less explicit than in Section 5.4.
score_reasons.engagement: The opening question is consequential and concrete, the image grid makes the intervention inspectable, and the main results have a discernible progression: positive alignment can coexist with high error, aggregate alignment can conceal weak painter pairs, and changing the evaluation choice can change the ordering. Figure 2’s magnified detail panels and Figure 3’s numeric heatmaps reward inspection. The ending is accurate but could preserve more of this distinctive diagnostic payoff with a small replacement rather than additional length.

strengths: Section 4.1, page 5, gives a specific measured lightness gap and then intuitive no/exact/doubled-response benchmarks before Equations 1–3; this makes the core distinction between alignment and mismatch unusually accessible.

Figure 1, page 4, displays every prompt condition for the same brief across all six configurations. Its caption explains the viewing sequence, selection rule, display crops and absence of matched historical compositions.

Figure 2, page 7, uses common axes and magnified Monet/Sisley/Pissarro panels to make a subtle pattern visible; Figure 3, page 8, then supplies all-feature pair estimates and explicit interpretations of 0, 1 and negative values.

Section 5.4 and Table 4, page 9, explain both reversals through concrete numbers and their evaluation meaning, including why shrinking a near-unit aligned response can reduce total error without changing an image.
Section 5.5 and Table 5 clearly show which adjusted comparisons change after source correction, while explicitly identifying the audit as AI-only and the corrected comparisons as retrospective.

The manuscript repeatedly preserves the distinction between its finite digital reference target and perceptual fidelity without requiring readers to inspect the repository; optional appendices retain substantial methodological detail and contrary historical evidence.

findings.issue: The phrase “The lowest held-out mean error estimate then shifts from FLUX.2 Max to GPT Image 2” compresses the uncalibrated and calibrated comparisons into a single label. The table later makes the distinction clear, but an abstract-only reader has to infer that FLUX leads on the uncalibrated score and GPT Image 2 on the held-out calibrated score.
findings.reader_effect: The diagnostic headline can briefly sound like a change between two versions of the same held-out score, obscuring which evaluation choice causes the change.
findings.suggested_change: Replace that sentence with “FLUX.2 Max has the lowest uncalibrated error estimate; GPT Image 2 has the lowest held-out calibrated estimate, without changing images.” This is a local replacement that keeps the abstract below 155 words and preserves the descriptive, image-unchanged claim.

findings.issue: The conclusion recaps shared change and aggregate alignment but leaves the painter-pair and calibration findings implicit, despite their prominence in the abstract and the narrative payoff of Sections 5.3–5.4.
findings.reader_effect: The final takeaway is somewhat more generic than the evidence just presented; the reader may retain detection-versus-matching while losing why aggregate error alone is insufficient.
findings.suggested_change: Replace the final sentence with a concise synthesis such as “Uneven painter-pair alignment and calibration-dependent error ordering show why detecting a name response and matching painter differences remain distinct.” Use a replacement within the existing paragraph, preserving the 22-page limit and avoiding any claim of statistical superiority after calibration.

summary: Excellent editorial communication for the specified audience and bounded digital-reference comparison. The central question, experiment, score interpretation and qualified findings stand on their own in the main text, and the figures support the narrative. Only localized clarification of the abstract’s calibration headline and a more distinctive closing synthesis are recommended; no new evidence or broader validation is needed for these edits.
